senses: vt. 取得（成果）；收割（庄稼）
reap.usage: 助记:今年reap(收获)了heap(大量)水稻；麦子成熟ripe之后才能收割reap；reap a/the harvest享受成果；串词记忆：玉米熟(ripe)了，农民可以收割(reap)了；索引p415

ex.en: They are now reaping the rewards of all their hard work.
ex.zh: 现在，他们的全部辛劳都得到了回报。

ex.en: Students who form good habits early will reap the benefits later.
ex.zh: 早养成好习惯的学生日后会收获益处。

ex.en: Investors reaped huge profits when the company went public.
ex.zh: 公司上市后，投资者获得了丰厚的利润。

senses: adj. 后部的,后面的,背部的
v. 抚养,培养;栽种;饲养
rear.usage: 同义back;反义front adj.前面的,前部的；多数父母希望可以把自己的孩子抚养（rear）成真正（really）有用的人

ex.en: Nothing gets people talking like the suggestion that child rearing is anything less than a completely fulfilling, life-enriching experience.
ex.zh: 没有什么比育儿绝非完全是成就自我、丰富生活的体验这一提议更能引发人们的讨论了。

ex.en: Please use the door at the rear of the building during the repairs.
ex.zh: 维修期间请使用大楼后部的门。

ex.en: Many parents choose to rear their children in the countryside rather than in big cities.
ex.zh: 许多父母选择在乡下而不是大城市抚养孩子。

ex.en: It was with these great revelations that a new kind of philosophy founded in reason was born.
ex.zh: 正是随着这些伟大的思想启示,一种建立在理性基础上的新哲学诞生了。

ex.en: We reason together, challenge, revise, and complete each other's reasoning and each other's conceptions of reason.
ex.zh: 我们共同推理、质疑、修改，并完善彼此的推理和对理性的理解。

ex.en: For safety reasons, visitors are asked to leave the building by six o'clock.
ex.zh: 出于安全原因，请访客在六点前离开大楼。

reasonable.usage: [族]reasonably 合乎逻辑地；明智地；[近]sensible 明智的；合理的；adj.有道理的，合情理的；通 情达理；索引p415

ex.en: They could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.
ex.zh: 在等待搜查令期间，他们可以采取合理措施，来确保手机中的数据不会被删除或修改。

ex.en: It seems reasonable to assume that consumers will change their habits only when prices reflect the true cost of production.
ex.zh: 合理的推断是，只有当价格反映真实生产成本时，消费者才会改变其消费习惯。

ex.en: The committee set a reasonable deadline, giving researchers enough time to verify their results before publication.
ex.zh: 委员会设定了一个合理的期限，让研究人员有足够的时间在发表前核实结果。

senses: ad. 合乎逻辑地；明智地
adv. 合情合理地；明智地；通情达理地；尚可
n. [U] 推想；推理；理性的观点
vt. 使安心，打消……的疑虑
vt. 使……安心,使……恢复信心
reassure.usage: re(再)+assure(保证)→再次保证→使安心;派生reassurance n.放心

rebel.usage: 记：re-（反对）+bel（战争）→为反对残暴的统治者而发起战争→反抗；re(反复)+bel(联想bell铃)→反复敲铃提醒城里有叛乱者；索引p415

ex.en: The participants filled out questionnaires about how often they did things that were altruistic and positive, like sacrificing their own interests to help a friend, or rebellious and negative, like getting drunk or staying out late.
ex.zh: 参与者填写了问卷，内容是关于他们做利他的、积极的事情（例如牺牲自己的利益帮助朋友）的频率，以及做叛逆的、消极的事情（例如醉酒或晚归）的频率。

ex.en: Teenagers often rebel against their parents' rules.
ex.zh: 青少年常常反抗父母的规矩。

ex.en: The rebels seized control of the capital within days.
ex.zh: 叛军在几天内就控制了首都。

ex.en: The rebellion was crushed within weeks, and its leaders were executed.
ex.zh: 叛乱在几周内被镇压，其领导人被处决。

ex.en: Teenage rebellion is often a natural step towards independence.
ex.zh: 青春期的反叛往往是走向独立的自然一步。

ex.en: Farmers rose in rebellion against the new taxes imposed by the government.
ex.zh: 农民奋起反抗政府征收的新税。

rebound.usage: v.弹回；反弹 n.弹回，反弹；篮板球；复兴

senses: vt. 回忆起；召回（某人）；召回（产品）

ex.en: I can recall the day my grandfather died and the sadness I felt when we went to the hospital the day before.
ex.zh: 我可以回忆起祖父去世那天的情景和前一天我们去医院看望他时我的伤心欲绝。

ex.en: The company recalled thousands of cars because of a fault in the braking system.
ex.zh: 由于制动系统存在故障，该公司召回了数千辆汽车。

ex.en: Older people often recall distant events clearly but forget what happened yesterday.
ex.zh: 老年人往往能清楚地回忆起久远的事情，却忘记昨天发生了什么。

senses: vi. 逐渐远离；逐渐减弱；退去
vi. 后退,退缩；缩小；收回意见
recede.usage: re(back回来)+cede(go走)→走回来→后退；v.逐渐远离；减弱

ex.en: As the flood waters receded, the full extent of the damage became clear.
ex.zh: 随着洪水退去，损失的全部程度才变得清晰。

ex.en: Memories of the hardship gradually receded as living standards improved.
ex.zh: 随着生活水平的提高，对艰难岁月的记忆逐渐淡去。

ex.en: His hairline had receded noticeably since we last met.
ex.zh: 自从我们上次见面以来，他的发际线明显后移了。

receipt.usage: 记：re-（回）+ceipt（收到）→收到还款后，某人返回给对方的凭证→收据；receive意为"接收"，买完东西接收到的票据为"收据"

ex.en: The machine issues a paper receipt on request.
ex.zh: 如果需要，该机器可提供收据小票。

ex.en: Please keep the receipt in case you need to return the goods.
ex.zh: 请保留收据，以备退货之需。

ex.en: On receipt of your payment, we will dispatch the goods immediately.
ex.zh: 收到您的付款后，我们将立即发货。

senses: vt. 接收，接到（抽象的东西）
vt. 接到；收到；体验；对……做出反应
receive.usage: v.得到，收到；接待，招待； 接收

ex.en: Students who receive scholarships are expected to maintain high grades.
ex.zh: 获得奖学金的学生应保持优异的成绩。

ex.en: She received a warm welcome when she returned to her home village.
ex.zh: 她回到家乡村庄时受到了热情的接待。

ex.en: The hospital is receiving hundreds of patients injured in the earthquake.
ex.zh: 这家医院正在接收数百名在地震中受伤的病人。

senses: n. [U] （无线电或电视等信号的）接收（效果）
reception.usage: 记：re-（回）+cept（拿）+-ion（名词后缀）→酒店里拿回押金的地方→接待处；n.接待处；欢迎；接收，招待 会；索引p415

ex.en: Please leave your key at the reception desk when you go out.
ex.zh: 外出时请把钥匙留在接待处。

ex.en: The new policy received a warm reception from business leaders.
ex.zh: 新政策受到了商界领袖的热烈欢迎。

ex.en: The radio gets poor reception in mountainous areas.
ex.zh: 在山区这台收音机接收效果很差。

ex.en: This may be because some people do not have the genes necessary to generate particular smell receptors in the nose.
ex.zh: 这可能是因为，某些人缺少一种在鼻子里产生某种特定气味的感受器所必要的基因。

senses: n. 经济衰退,经济萎缩
n. 衰退，不景气；退后；撤回
recession.usage: [记] re-（回）+cess（走）+ -ion →往回走→衰退；[记] re-(回)+cess(走)+-ion →往回走→衰退；n.经济衰退；re（重复，回去）+cess（走）+ion→经济往回走→衰退；the Great Recession：特指1929-1933年间发源于美国的全球经济危机；索引p415

ex.en: A lot of companies have been adversely affected by the recession.
ex.zh: 许多公司受到经济衰退的不利影响。

ex.en: During the recession, many firms cut training budgets first, a decision they later regretted when skilled workers became scarce.
ex.zh: 经济衰退期间，许多公司最先削减培训预算，当技术工人变得短缺时，它们才为这一决定感到后悔。

ex.en: Economists disagree about when the country will emerge from recession, but few expect a rapid recovery.
ex.zh: 经济学家对该国何时能走出经济衰退看法不一，但很少有人指望经济会迅速复苏。

recipe.usage: re(重复)+cipe(联想食谱)→他一再地提到"食谱"→食谱

ex.en: Each month we feature easy low-fat recipes.
ex.zh: 我们每个月都会推出一些特色的简易低脂食谱。

ex.en: The secret recipe has been passed down through four generations.
ex.zh: 这个秘方已传承了四代。

ex.en: Cutting costs without improving quality is a recipe for disaster.
ex.zh: 在不提高质量的情况下一味削减成本，后果必定是灾难性的。

senses: adj. 容易接受的,感受性强的

ex.en: She was the recipient of this year's award for young scientists.
ex.zh: 她是今年青年科学家奖的获得者。

ex.en: Recipients of the scholarship must maintain high grades.
ex.zh: 奖学金获得者必须保持优秀成绩。

ex.en: Each recipient of the letter was asked to reply within a week.
ex.zh: 每位收信人被要求在一周内回复。

reciprocal.usage: 同义:mutual;派生reciprocate v.回报,报答；互给,互换

ex.en: Rats have been shown to engage in multiple forms of reciprocal help and cooperation.
ex.zh: 已有研究表明，老鼠会进行多种形式的互助及合作。

ex.en: The two universities have a reciprocal arrangement to exchange students each year.
ex.zh: 这两所大学有互惠安排，每年交换学生。

ex.en: Trust between nations grows when favours are reciprocal rather than one-sided.
ex.zh: 当恩惠是相互而非单方面的时候，国家间的信任才会增长。

senses: n. 背诵,朗诵,当众吟诵
vt. 朗诵，背诵；详述，(口头)列举
recite.usage: re(again再)+cite(call召唤)→再次唤起→背诵；索引p415

ex.en: The children proudly recited a poem they had learned for the festival.
ex.zh: 孩子们自豪地背诵了他们为节日学会的一首诗。

ex.en: He could recite the names of all the presidents in order.
ex.zh: 他能按顺序背出所有总统的名字。

ex.en: She recited the list of complaints without pausing for breath.
ex.zh: 她一口气列举了一连串抱怨，连停顿都没有。

senses: adj. (of) 鲁莽的;不顾危险的
adj. 鲁莽的，不顾后果的
reckless.usage: 派生recklessly adv.轻率鲁莽地;recklessness n.鲁莽；reck(计算)+less(否定后缀)→不计后果的→鲁莽的；索引p415

ex.en: He had always been reckless with money.
ex.zh: 他花钱总是大手大脚。

ex.en: He was fined for driving at a reckless speed on the motorway.
ex.zh: 他因在高速公路上鲁莽超速驾驶而被罚款。

ex.en: It was reckless of the ministry to ignore the warnings of its own scientists.
ex.zh: 该部门无视自己科学家的警告，实在鲁莽。

senses: adv. 鲁莽地；不顾后果地

reckon.usage: 典型考题:The experts reckoned that...calculate指具体数字计算;doubt怀疑;propose建议；索引p415

ex.en: This time experts reckon that prices are about 40% down on their peak on average.
ex.zh: 这一次，专家估计，价格平均比峰值下降了40%左右。

ex.en: The American Society of News Editors reckons that 13,500 newsroom jobs have gone since 2007.
ex.zh: 据美国新闻编辑协会估算，自2007年以来新闻编辑部门的职位已经缩减了13,500个。

ex.en: Analysts reckon that the company will report record profits this year.
ex.zh: 分析人士估计该公司今年将报告创纪录的利润。

senses: v. 开垦；利用；取回，拿回；回收

phrases.p: reclaim sb. from a life of vice

reclaim.usage: 派生reclamation n.开垦开拓;改造感化;废物回收利用;真题考认领义；re（向后，相反）+claim（喊）→喊回来→取回，拿回；索引p415

ex.en: You'll have to go to the police station to reclaim your wallet.
ex.zh: 你得到警察局去认领你的钱包。

ex.en: The Netherlands has reclaimed large areas of land from the sea.
ex.zh: 荷兰从海中围垦了大片土地。

ex.en: The city plans to reclaim the old industrial site for housing.
ex.zh: 该市计划收回旧工业区用于建设住宅。

senses: vt. 重新分类，重新安排等级

recognise.usage: 书中亦作recognize/-ize；vt.认可例为2014年阅读

ex.en: On one level, they don't even recognise the person in the picture as themselves.
ex.zh: 在某种程度上，他们甚至不承认照片上的那个人就是自己。

recognition.usage: n.承认，接受；表彰，赞 誉；认出，识别 /ʌn'rekə ɡ naɪzd/ 1 adj.未被承认的;未被认可 的；①n.识别 ②n.认可:a global recognition全球认可；索引p415

ex.en: She has won international recognition for her research on climate change.
ex.zh: 她对气候变化的研究赢得了国际认可。

ex.en: Facial recognition technology is now widely used at airports.
ex.zh: 人脸识别技术现已广泛应用于机场。

ex.en: He deserves recognition for his years of quiet service.
ex.zh: 他多年的默默奉献应当得到承认。

ex.en: I recognized her voice on the phone immediately, though we had not spoken for years.
ex.zh: 尽管我们多年未通电话，我还是立刻听出了她的声音。

ex.en: The government finally recognized the union's right to negotiate on behalf of workers.
ex.zh: 政府最终承认了工会代表工人谈判的权利。

ex.en: Doctors are trained to recognize the early symptoms of the disease.
ex.zh: 医生接受培训以识别这种疾病的早期症状。

recommend.usage: 同义 advise；反义 disapprove；派生 recommendation n. 推荐，建议；v.建议；推荐，介绍；使受欢迎；发音类似"来叩门的"→来叩门的人可能是来提建议的→建议；索引p415

ex.en: All the experts we spoke with highly recommend walking.
ex.zh: 我们采访过的所有专家都强烈推荐步行。

ex.en: But that's exactly the kind of false cheerfulness that positive psychologists wouldn't recommend.
ex.zh: 但那不是真正的快乐，也正是积极心理学家所不推荐的。

ex.en: Doctors strongly recommend that adults spend at least thirty minutes a day on moderate physical exercise.
ex.zh: 医生强烈建议成年人每天至少进行三十分钟适度的体育锻炼。

recommendation.usage: n.提议；推荐，介绍；推荐信；索引p415

senses: v. 重新考虑,重新审议

ex.en: Faced with falling sales, the board was forced to reconsider its pricing strategy.
ex.zh: 面对销量下滑，董事会被迫重新考虑其定价策略。

ex.en: The committee agreed to reconsider the application after new evidence emerged.
ex.zh: 在出现新证据后，委员会同意重新审议该申请。

ex.en: He urged the government to reconsider its decision to close the rural schools.
ex.zh: 他敦促政府重新考虑关闭乡村学校的决定。

senses: v. 修复;重建,重造;重现描述;使重现
n. 记录,记载,最高记录;最佳成绩

ex.en: The thermometer recorded the highest temperature of the summer so far.
ex.zh: 温度计记录了今夏以来的最高气温。

ex.en: She holds the world record for the women's marathon.
ex.zh: 她保持着女子马拉松的世界纪录。

ex.en: The company has a poor record on safety, according to the official report.
ex.zh: 据官方报告，该公司在安全方面记录不佳。

senses: vt. 收回（成本）；弥补（亏损）

recover.usage: 同义 regain，restore；反义 lose v. 丢失，丧失；adj.重新找到的

ex.en: It took the city nearly a decade to recover from the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 这座城市花了近十年才从金融危机中恢复过来。

ex.en: Police recovered most of the stolen paintings within a week.
ex.zh: 警方在一周内追回了大部分被盗画作。

ex.en: Doctors expect her to recover fully within a few months.
ex.zh: 医生预计她几个月内就能完全康复。

senses: n. 恢复；痊愈；改善；回升；复苏
recovery.usage: n.痊愈；恢复，复苏；小时候发烧时妈妈给我盖很多被子，她说多盖（cover）被子捂捂汗就康复（recovery）了；索引p415

ex.en: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.
ex.zh: 是的，2008年全球经济危机后，经济已经开始复苏，但是在健康、教育等关键指标领域，主要经济体一直处于下滑状态。

ex.en: There has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash.
ex.zh: 自2008年全球危机以来，经济出现了复苏的苗头。

ex.en: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.
ex.zh: 是的，在2008年全球经济海啸之后有萌芽性的经济复苏，但是在诸如健康和教育领域的关键指数上，主要经济体还是持续下滑。

recreation.usage: 记：re-（再）+cre（创造）+-ation（名词后缀）→再次创造出来→重建；辨析:recreation指放松身心的消遣;amusement指轻松随便的逗乐;entertainment指引起兴趣逗乐的行动；re(再，重复)+creat(创造)+ion(名词后缀)→再创作一些有趣的东西→娱乐，消遣；索引p415

ex.en: But traditionally they've focused on wildlife, watersheds and opportunities for recreation.
ex.zh: 但历来他们关注的都是野生动物、水域和再造的机会。

ex.en: The lake is a popular spot for boating and other forms of recreation.
ex.zh: 这个湖是划船和其他娱乐活动的热门场所。

ex.en: Gardening is his main form of recreation after retirement.
ex.zh: 园艺是他退休后的主要消遣。

phrases.p: the common practice of recruiting players from all over the world
phrases.m: 从世界各地招募球员的常见做法

recruit.usage: [族] recruitment n. 招募；招聘；[近] mobilize vt.&vi. 动员；同义 enroll，enlist；v.招聘，招收；招募 n.新兵；新成员；re（联想成“阿姨”）+cru（发音类似“可人”）+it（它）→阿姨也可以加入这个俱乐部，成为“新成员”。；索引p415

ex.en: They recruited several new members to the club.
ex.zh: 他们吸收了几名新成员进入俱乐部。

ex.en: That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs.
ex.zh: 这表明，为日益艰难的工作招募顶尖候选人符合公司更广泛的利益。

ex.en: Small firms often struggle to recruit talented graduates because they cannot match the salaries offered by large corporations.
ex.zh: 小公司往往难以招募到优秀的毕业生，因为它们无法与大型企业提供的薪酬相匹敌。

senses: n. [C] 征兵人员；招聘人员
n. 征兵人员，招聘人员

ex.en: The recruiter screens hundreds of applications before inviting anyone to interview.
ex.zh: 招聘人员在邀请面试之前会筛选数百份申请。

ex.en: Military recruiters visited the campus to speak with graduating students.
ex.zh: 征兵人员来到校园与毕业生交谈。

ex.en: A good recruiter looks beyond a candidate's grades to their actual abilities.
ex.zh: 优秀的招聘者不只看候选人的成绩，还看他们的实际能力。

ex.en: The company moved quickly to rectify the error in customers' bills.
ex.zh: 公司迅速采取行动纠正客户账单中的错误。

ex.en: Steps must be taken to rectify the shortage of nurses in rural hospitals.
ex.zh: 必须采取措施纠正乡村医院护士短缺的问题。

ex.en: Engineers worked overnight to rectify the fault in the signalling system.
ex.zh: 工程师连夜排除信号系统的故障。

senses: n. [C] 教区长；学院院长；学校校长
vi. 复发,重现,再来,回想

phrases.m: 反复出现在某人的作品中
(指想法、事情等)在头脑中重现

recur.usage: 记：re-（重复）+cur（发生）→重复发生→反复出现；v.再发生，反复出现；re(再次)+cur(联想成occur“发生”)→再次发生→再发生；索引p415

ex.en: Cartwright believes one can exercise conscious control over recurring bad dreams.
ex.zh: 卡特赖特认为，一个人可以有意识地控制反复出现的噩梦。

ex.en: If the same error keeps recurring in the data, the entire research design may need to be re-examined.
ex.zh: 如果同样的错误在数据中反复出现，可能就需要重新审视整个研究设计。

ex.en: The theme of loneliness recurs throughout her novels, reflecting her own years of living abroad.
ex.zh: 孤独这一主题在她的小说中反复出现，反映出她多年旅居国外的经历。

recurrent.usage: adj.复发的；周期性的， 经常发生的；adj.复发的；周期性的，经常发生 的

senses: vt. 使再循环,反复利用;整修,改建
n. 再循环,再生,重复利用
v. ①补救，弥补(过失)，掩饰……之不足
②挽回影响，改变印象；③拯救，救赎
④偿清，付清；兑换，兑现；赎回；⑤履行，遵守(诺言)
v. 改变……的本质(或界限)重新定义,使重新考虑
v. 使改变方向;使改变路线;改寄(信件)
vt. 使改变用途；使改变方向

ex.en: The government has promised to reduce carbon emissions by a third.
ex.zh: 政府已承诺将碳排放减少三分之一。

ex.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可以降低患心脏病的风险。

ex.en: The new measures aim to reduce traffic in the city centre.
ex.zh: 新措施旨在减少市中心的交通流量。

ex.en: The company announced a ten percent reduction in staff.
ex.zh: 公司宣布裁员百分之十。

ex.en: Price reductions have failed to attract more customers.
ex.zh: 降价未能吸引到更多顾客。

ex.en: The deal will lead to a significant reduction in carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 该协议将使碳排放大幅减少。

senses: n. 过多,多余,冗余,重复
adj. 多余的,冗长的,累赘的,过剩的;后备的
adj. 被裁减的；多余的，不需要的
redundant.usage: re（只，再）+dundant（可联想abundant“大量的”）→又是大量的，肯定就是“多余的”。

ex.en: The programme organizes training for redundant workers.
ex.zh: 该方案为多余的工人组织培训。

ex.en: The new machines made hundreds of clerical staff redundant.
ex.zh: 新机器使数百名文职人员变得多余。

ex.en: Delete any redundant words to make your essay more concise.
ex.zh: 删掉多余的词，使你的文章更简洁。

refer.usage: [族] reference n. 谈及（链接P35）；[族] referral n. 送交，转送；v.提到，谈及；查阅，参考； 关于，指；v.提到；涉及；查阅，参考；v.提到，谈及；查阅，参考； 指，关于；索引p415

ex.en: This refers to discrimination against those whose surnames begin with a letter in the lower half of the alphabet.
ex.zh: 这指的是对那些姓氏开头字母位于字母表后半部分的人的歧视。

ex.en: In academic writing, the term refers to any influence that operates outside the individual's conscious awareness.
ex.zh: 在学术写作中，这个术语指任何在个体无意识层面发挥作用的影响。

ex.en: Readers should refer to the original study before drawing firm conclusions from second-hand summaries.
ex.zh: 读者在根据二手概述得出确切结论之前，应当查阅原始研究。

senses: n. 提及，涉及；参考，参照；查阅；参考书目；推荐信(人)
n. 提及，涉及；参考，参考书目
reference.usage: n.提及，谈到；参考，查阅 v.引用，参照；n.提及，谈到；参考，查阅 v.查阅，参考；给（书）等附 参考资料；refer是动词，动词后加ence就是名词。；索引p415

ex.en: The book is full of references to growing up in India.
ex.zh: 这本书谈到许多在印度怎样长大成人的事。

ex.en: Her speech contained several pointed references to the company's recent failures, which embarrassed the managers present.
ex.zh: 她的演讲多次尖锐地提及该公司近来的失败，令在场的经理们颇为尴尬。

ex.en: Every claim in the essay must be supported by a clear reference to a published source.
ex.zh: 文章中的每一个论点都必须有对已出版文献的明确引用作为支撑。

senses: v. [喻]改进,使变得完善(或精妙)
v. 精炼，提纯；改进，改善
refine.usage: re(再，又)+fine(表示"好")→已经很好了，让它再好→提炼，精炼

ex.en: She has refined her playing technique over the years.
ex.zh: 这些年来，她改进了自己的演奏技巧。

ex.en: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used as fuel.
ex.zh: 原油必须经过提炼才能用作燃料。

ex.en: The team refined its design after testing the prototype in extreme conditions.
ex.zh: 该团队在极端条件下测试原型后改进了设计。

phrases.m: 反映人类的最高价值观

reflect.usage: re-(回)+flect(弯曲)→（光）折回→反射；[族] reflection；[族] reflection n. 反映；显示（链接P251）；[近] mirror vt. 反映；re（回；向后）+flect（弯曲）→向后弯曲→把光弯回去→反射；索引p415

ex.en: This material absorbs the sound, and doesn't reflect it.
ex.zh: 这种材料吸收声音，但不反射声音。

ex.en: The drop in share prices reflects growing concern about the economy.
ex.zh: 股价下跌反映出人们对经济日益担忧。

ex.en: Take some time to reflect on what you have learned.
ex.zh: 花些时间反思一下自己学到的东西。

reflection.usage: [族] reflective a. 深思的；[反] 遮蔽、隐藏；记 re-(回)+flect(曲折)+-ion(名词后缀)→射向镜子的光线曲折返回的现象→反射；亦作 reflexion

ex.en: Your clothes are often a reflection of your personality.
ex.zh: 你的穿着常常反映出你的个性。

ex.en: After a period of quiet reflection, he decided to accept the offer.
ex.zh: 经过一段时间的静心思索，他决定接受这个提议。

ex.en: She admired her reflection in the shop window as she passed.
ex.zh: 路过时，她欣赏着橱窗里自己的映像。

reform.usage: [族] reformer n. 改革者；革新者；[族] reformation n. 改革；变革；re（再）+form（形式）→再换个形式→改革，改善；索引p415

ex.en: Publishers continue to push for sweeping reforms.
ex.zh: 出版商继续力求大刀阔斧的改革。

ex.en: True educational reform requires more than new textbooks; it demands a fundamental change in how teachers are trained.
ex.zh: 真正的教育改革需要的不仅仅是新教材，还要求在教师培养方式上进行根本变革。

ex.en: Critics argue that the tax reform mainly benefited large corporations rather than ordinary wage earners.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，这次税制改革主要让大公司受益，而非普通工薪阶层。

refrain.usage: re（热）+f（伏）+rain（雨）→三伏天很热终于下雨，无法克制内心的喜悦→克制；索引p415

ex.en: California has asked the justices to refrain from a sweeping ruling.
ex.zh: 加利福尼亚州呼吁法官不要作出太笼统的裁定。

ex.en: Please refrain from smoking in the hospital corridors.
ex.zh: 请不要在医院走廊里吸烟。

ex.en: The bank urged investors to refrain from panic selling.
ex.zh: 该银行敦促投资者避免恐慌性抛售。

senses: v. 使恢复活力,使振作精神
v.（使）精神振作，（使）精力恢复
vt. 使更新；使精神振作；使想起
refresh.usage: re(再)+fresh(新鲜的)→再一次新鲜的→振作精神，恢复精力；索引p415

ex.en: It was specifically to provide city dwellers with spaces for leisure where they could experience "a refreshing air".
ex.zh: 它专门为城市居民提供休闲空间，在那里他们可以体验“清新的空气”。

ex.en: Are you looking to refresh your image or pivot it?
ex.zh: 你想呈现一个完全崭新的形象，还是在原有形象的基础上稍作调整？

ex.en: A cup of tea will refresh you after the long journey.
ex.zh: 长途旅行后喝杯茶能让你恢复精神。

ex.en: Thousands of families took refuge in schools after the floods destroyed their homes.
ex.zh: 洪水摧毁家园后，数千户家庭在学校避难。

ex.en: The library offered a quiet refuge from the noise of the city.
ex.zh: 图书馆是躲避城市喧嚣的一方安静净土。

ex.en: He sought refuge in work after the death of his wife.
ex.zh: 妻子去世后，他在工作中寻求慰藉。

refund.usage: re(回来)+fund(金钱)→把钱退回去→退款

ex.en: Your money will be refunded in full.
ex.zh: 您会得到全额退款。

ex.en: Passengers are entitled to a refund if the flight is cancelled.
ex.zh: 如果航班取消，乘客有权获得退款。

ex.en: The shop refused to give a refund without a valid receipt.
ex.zh: 没有有效收据，商店拒绝退款。

ex.en: His refusal to answer the questions angered the committee.
ex.zh: 他拒绝回答问题，激怒了委员会。

ex.en: The company's refusal to cut prices surprised the market.
ex.zh: 该公司拒绝降价，令市场感到意外。

ex.en: She shook her head in firm refusal.
ex.zh: 她坚定地摇头拒绝。

refuse.usage: [族] refusal n. 拒绝，回绝；[近] deny vt. 拒绝；拒绝给予；n. 读['refjuːs]；re（回去）+fuse（流）→给我的东西，我再让它流回去就是"拒绝"→拒绝；索引p415

ex.en: Readers are paying more for slimmer products. Some papers even had the nerve to refuse delivery to distant suburbs.
ex.zh: 读者付费更多却获得缩水的内容。一些报社甚至敢拒绝向边远郊区递送报纸。

ex.en: Now he is suing the casino, charging that it should have refused his patronage because it knew he was addicted.
ex.zh: 现在，他正在起诉赌场，控告说赌场本应该拒绝他入内，因为赌场知道他已经赌博成瘾。

ex.en: The embassy refused to comment on the reported talks.
ex.zh: 大使馆拒绝对所报道的会谈发表评论。

senses: vt. 否认…的正确性(或真实性)
refute.usage: contradict 的近义词；re（回）+fut（打）→打回去→驳斥。近义：rebut vt. 驳斥

senses: v. 重新获得,恢复(能力或品质等)

phrases.p: give my best regards to your mother

regard.usage: [族] regarding prep. 关于；[族] regardless adv. 不顾；不加理会；v.认为，把……看作；注视，凝 视 n.尊重，敬佩；关心，关注； 致意；regardless of 不管；不顾；索引p415

ex.en: The court cannot regard the First Amendment as...
ex.zh: 法庭不能把第一修正案看作……

ex.en: This is why researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing.
ex.zh: 这就是为什么研究人员普遍认为适量的所谓道德内疚是一件好事。

ex.en: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country's success, the world looks very different.
ex.zh: 当国内生产总值(GDP)不再被视为衡量一个国家成功的唯一标准时，世界的样子就大不一样。

ex.en: It may just encourage people to talk more honestly about their feelings regarding race issues.
ex.zh: 它可能只是鼓励人们更诚实地谈论他们对种族问题的感受。

ex.en: In contrast to France's actions, Denmark's fashion industry agreed last month on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models.
ex.zh: 与法国的做法不同，丹麦时尚行业上个月就模特的年龄、健康和其他特性相关规定和制裁达成了一致。

ex.en: The committee received numerous complaints regarding the new parking rules.
ex.zh: 委员会收到了大量关于新停车规定的投诉。

senses: adj. 不留心的,不注意的

ex.en: The scheme is open to all residents, regardless of age or income.
ex.zh: 该计划对所有居民开放，无论年龄或收入如何。

ex.en: He continued the experiment regardless of the risks involved.
ex.zh: 尽管存在风险，他仍继续进行实验。

ex.en: The deadline will be enforced regardless of any individual circumstances.
ex.zh: 无论个人情况如何，截止日期都将严格执行。

senses: n. 政权，政体；社会制度；管理体制
n. 社会制度；管理体制
regime.usage: [近] system n. 制度 [近] government n. 政体；词根记忆：reg(rule,统治)+ime→政权；索引p415

ex.en: Crowds celebrated the downfall of the old regime.
ex.zh: 成群的人们欢庆旧政权的垮台。

ex.en: When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above "mere" politics and "embody" a spirit of national unity.
ex.zh: 当公众舆论出现严重的两极分化时，正如佛朗哥政权结束之后那样，君主们可以超越"单纯的"政治概念，"体现"国家统一的精神。

ex.en: The new tax regime will take effect at the start of next year.
ex.zh: 新税制将于明年初生效。

region.usage: 族：regional a. 地区的；区域的；近：area n. 地区，区域；[族] regional adj. 地区的；区域的；整个地区的；n.地区，区域；行政区；发音类似"瑞金"(江西省的一个地方)→地方，区域；索引p415

ex.en: This is one of the most densely populated regions of North America.
ex.zh: 这是北美人口最为稠密的地区之一。

ex.en: Rainfall in the region has declined sharply over the past decade, forcing farmers to switch to drought-resistant crops.
ex.zh: 过去十年该地区降雨量急剧减少，迫使农民改种耐旱作物。

ex.en: The new railway will connect remote regions to the coast, opening them to trade and tourism.
ex.zh: 这条新铁路将把偏远地区与海岸连接起来，使其向贸易和旅游开放。

senses: vt. 正式提出（意见、抗议等）
register.usage: enroll 的近义词；[族] registration n. 登记；注册；挂号；n.登记表，注册簿 v.登记，注册；发表意见；re（联想成“阿姨”）+gister（联想成sister“姐姐”）→阿姨同意让姐姐和那个男人“登记”结婚了。；索引p415

ex.en: They argue that all Internet users should be forced to register and identify themselves.
ex.zh: 他们认为，所有的互联网用户都应该被强制注册并证明自己的身份。

ex.en: All visitors must register at the front desk and wear a badge while inside the building.
ex.zh: 所有来访者必须在前台登记，并在楼内佩戴胸牌。

ex.en: Voters who fail to register before the deadline will not be allowed to take part in the election.
ex.zh: 未在截止日期前登记的选民将不能参加选举投票。

regret.usage: [族] regrettable adj. 令人惋惜的；可惜的；索引p415

ex.en: She immediately regretted her harsh words, but it was too late to take them back.
ex.zh: 她立刻后悔自己说了刻薄的话，但为时已晚。

ex.en: Much to my regret, I will be unable to attend the conference.
ex.zh: 非常遗憾，我将无法出席这次会议。

ex.en: He expressed deep regret over the decision he had made years before.
ex.zh: 他对多年前做出的决定深表悔恨。

senses: adj. 令人惋惜的；可惜的
adv. 抱歉地;遗憾地;可悲地

regular.usage: 族：regularity n. 规律性；经常性；反：irregular a. 无规律的；[族] regularly adv. 定期地；经常地；[族] irregular adj. 不规则的（链接P351）；adj.规则的;频繁的；通常的 n.常客，老主顾

ex.en: We also hold a regular monthly meeting.
ex.zh: 我们还每月定期举行会议。

ex.en: He is a regular customer at the bookshop on the corner.
ex.zh: 他是街角书店的老顾客。

ex.en: Regular exercise reduces the risk of many chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 定期锻炼能降低患许多慢性病的风险。

ex.en: She regularly appears on TV.
ex.zh: 她经常在电视上露面。

senses: vt. (尤指通过规章)控制，管理
vt. 调节；（仪器等的）校准
regulate.usage: 族：regulator n. 监管者，监管机构；近：manage vt.&vi. 负责，管理；[族] regulation n. 法规；规章（链接P53）；adj. 规定的；必须使用的；v.管理；调节，调整；re(阿姨)+gu(规定)+late(迟到)→阿姨规定别迟到→调整生物钟→调节；词根记忆：reg(rule,统治

ex.en: Communities throughout New England have been attempting to regulate short-term rentals.
ex.zh: 整个新英格兰地区的各个社区一直在试图规范短期租赁。

ex.en: The order also declared that state and local governments couldn't regulate broadband providers either.
ex.zh: 该规定同时还宣布，各州和地方政府也不得对宽带供应商进行监管。

ex.en: The body has an internal clock that helps regulate sleep, body temperature and hormone levels.
ex.zh: 人体有一个内部生物钟，帮助调节睡眠、体温和激素水平。

senses: a. 规定的；必须使用的
adj. 规定的；必须使用的

phrases.m: 琐碎而烦人的种种规订

regulation.usage: reg（规则）+ul+-ation（名词后缀）→用来约束人行为的规则→规章制度。近义：statute n. 法令；法规。；n.规章制度，规则；管理，控 制 adj.规定的，正规的；n.规章制度，规则；管理，控制 adj.规定的；索引p415

ex.en: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 严格的工作解雇规定对生产力的增长产生不利影响，阻碍社会繁荣和人们的整体福祉。

ex.en: Strict safety regulation in the mining industry has sharply reduced accidents over the past two decades.
ex.zh: 严格的安全法规使采矿业的事故数量在过去二十年里大幅减少。

ex.en: Business leaders complain that excessive regulation raises costs and discourages investment in new technologies.
ex.zh: 企业界领袖抱怨说，过多的监管抬高了成本，抑制了对新技术的投资。

regulator.usage: n.监管者，管理者；调节器；索引p415

senses: a. 具有监管权的，监管的
a. (对工商业)具有监管权的，监管的
regulatory.usage: regulation 的词族拓展词。；adj.管理的，控制的，监管的；索引p415

ex.en: The bank was fined for failing to meet regulatory standards.
ex.zh: 该银行因未达到监管标准而被罚款。

ex.en: Regulatory approval is required before the new drug can be sold.
ex.zh: 新药上市前必须获得监管机构的批准。

ex.en: Businesses complain that overlapping regulatory bodies increase their costs.
ex.zh: 企业抱怨职能重叠的监管机构增加了它们的成本。

senses: n. 统治,统治权,统治时期;支配,影响
n. 君主统治时期；任期
reign.usage: 拓展：rein in 严格控制；加强管理。；索引p415

ex.en: Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt, which can rein in their nastier impulses.
ex.zh: 一些不那么有同情心的孩子可以通过感受更多的内疚来弥补那种缺失，这样就可以遏制他们更恶意的冲动。

ex.en: The palace was built early in the king's reign, when royal power was at its height.
ex.zh: 这座宫殿建于国王在位初期，当时王权正处于鼎盛时期。

ex.en: Confusion reigned in the trading hall as prices fell faster than anyone had predicted.
ex.zh: 价格下跌之快超出所有人的预料，交易大厅里一片混乱。

senses: n. 统治,支配;拘束物;牵制
v. 以缰绳控制;驾驭,统治;勒住马,止住
vi. 严加控制；(用缰绳)勒住(马)

ex.en: The government has kept a tight rein on public spending since the crisis.
ex.zh: 危机以来，政府一直严格控制公共开支。

ex.en: She gave free rein to her imagination when designing the garden.
ex.zh: 设计花园时，她任由自己的想象力自由发挥。

ex.en: New rules were introduced to rein in the power of the big technology firms.
ex.zh: 新规出台以约束大型科技公司的权力。

senses: v. 加强；充实；使更强烈；加固；给……加强力量
reinforce.usage: re（再）+in（进入）+force（力量）→再加力→增强。近义：strengthen vt. 加强；v.加强，强化；加固；re（再）+in（往里）+force（力量）→再往里增加力量→加强；加固；词根记忆：re(again,再)+in+forc(strong,强壮的)+e→使再次强壮→强化；索引p415

ex.en: This report strongly reinforces the view that the system must be changed.
ex.zh: 这份报告强有力地证实了必须进行制度改革的观点。

ex.en: But the ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government.
ex.zh: 但这项裁决强化了公民及其民选代表（而非法院）在确保平等参与政府事务上的需要。

ex.en: Repeated praise from teachers can reinforce a child's confidence and encourage independent thinking.
ex.zh: 老师反复的表扬能够增强孩子的自信心，并鼓励其独立思考。

ex.en: A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world.
ex.zh: 愤世嫉俗的人可能会推测，英国正濒临陷入一种无休止的自我庆贺的狂热之中，渴望为后脱欧时代重塑自我。

reject.usage: [族] rejection n. 拒绝；否决；[族]rejection n. 拒绝；re（回来或重复）+ject（抛，扔）→扔回来→拒绝接受；索引p415

ex.en: The bank has the option of accepting or rejecting this offer.
ex.zh: 银行可以选择接受或拒绝这个提议。

ex.en: If we know female job screeners are more likely to reject attractive female applicants, we can help screeners understand their biases—or hire outside screeners.
ex.zh: 如果我们认识到女性简历筛选人员更有可能拒绝有魅力的女性求职者，便可以帮简历筛选员认识到她们的偏见，或者聘用外界人士进行筛选。

ex.en: The committee voted to reject the proposal, arguing that its costs far outweighed its expected benefits.
ex.zh: 委员会投票否决了该提案，认为其成本远远超过预期收益。

senses: n. 拒绝；被抛弃的东西

ex.en: Her application ended in another painful rejection.
ex.zh: 她的申请再次遭到拒绝，令她痛苦。

ex.en: The rejection of the merger plan sent shares falling sharply.
ex.zh: 合并计划被否决，导致股价大幅下跌。

ex.en: He feared rejection, so he never applied for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 他害怕被拒绝，所以从未申请过奖学金。

senses: v. (使)感到高兴，(使)充满喜悦

relate.usage: [族] relation n. 关系；亲属（链接P154）；[族] related adj. 相关的；re(重复)+late(迟到)→讲述清楚迟到的原因→叙述；vi.与…有关例为2015年阅读；索引p415

ex.en: Office speak can help you figure out how you relate to your work and how your work defines who you are.
ex.zh: 办公室语言可以帮助你弄清楚你和工作之间的关系，以及你的工作如何定义你是谁。

ex.en: The issue of voluntary part-time relates to Obamacare because one of the main purposes was to allow people to get insurance outside of employment.
ex.zh: 自愿兼职工作之所以同奥巴马医改相关，是因为医改的主要目的之一就是允许没有正式工作的人们也能获得医保。

ex.en: Researchers found that students who can relate course material to their own experience learn more effectively.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现，能够把课程内容与自身经历联系起来的学生学习效果更好。

senses: adj. 相关的；有亲属关系的
related.usage: adj.相关的，有联系的；有亲 戚关系的；索引p415

ex.en: Police believe the two crimes are closely related.
ex.zh: 警方认为这两起罪案密切相关。

ex.en: The report examines problems related to urban transport.
ex.zh: 该报告审视了与城市交通相关的问题。

ex.en: Doctors are studying stress-related illnesses among office workers.
ex.zh: 医生们正在研究上班族中与压力相关的疾病。

phrases.m: 在数目、数量或大小上完全不/不太/部分相符

ex.en: They attach too much importance to public relations.
ex.zh: 他们太重视公共关系了。

ex.en: The study examines the relation between hours of screen time and the quality of children's sleep.
ex.zh: 这项研究考查了屏幕使用时间与儿童睡眠质量之间的关系。

ex.en: The report discusses wage growth in relation to productivity, a link that has weakened over recent decades.
ex.zh: 该报告讨论了工资增长与生产率之间的关系，近几十年来这一联系已有所减弱。

senses: n. 关系；关联；感情关系
n. （人、团体、国家之间的）关系；（事物之间的）关联；情爱关系

phrases.p: the relationship between A and B

ex.en: The relationship between the police and the local community has improved.
ex.zh: 警察和当地民众之间的关系已经得到改善。

ex.en: There is a close relationship between diet and cancer.
ex.zh: 饮食与癌症之间有密切的关联。

ex.en: The two countries are working to improve their trade relationship.
ex.zh: 两国正努力改善贸易关系。

relative.usage: [族] relatively adv. 相当地；相对地；relation 指亲属，包括近亲和有法律地位的家庭成员；relative 指亲戚，广泛指任何与你 有亲戚关系的人；索引p415

ex.en: Mary is going to get a little dog from one of her relatives.
ex.zh: 玛丽打算从她的一个亲戚那里领养一只小狗。

ex.en: All his relatives gathered to celebrate his ninetieth birthday.
ex.zh: 他所有的亲戚都聚在一起庆祝他的九十岁生日。

ex.en: We weighed the relative advantages of the two proposals.
ex.zh: 我们权衡了两个方案的相对优势。

senses: adv. 相当程度上;相当地;相对地

ex.en: Housing in the city remains relatively affordable for young families.
ex.zh: 对年轻家庭来说，这座城市的住房仍然相对买得起。

ex.en: The test is relatively simple compared with last year's version.
ex.zh: 与去年的版本相比，这项测试相对简单。

ex.en: The region was relatively untouched by the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 该地区受金融危机的影响相对较小。

senses: v. 中继转播,转播;传递;转达
n. 接替的一组人,替换队
vt. 接转；转播(电视节目等)；重新铺设

release.usage: [近] reveal vt. 揭示；透露；反义arrest v.逮捕,拘留；v.释放，放走，发布；re(阿姨)+lease(音似立誓)→阿姨立誓减肥要发布给大家→发布；索引p415

ex.en: Therefore, unless customers are prepared to sign release agreements, the use of AI may become somewhat restricted in the future.
ex.zh: 因此，除非客户准备签署发布协议，否则未来人工智能的使用可能会受到一定程度的限制。

ex.en: The company decided to release the survey results before the annual meeting to reassure anxious investors.
ex.zh: 该公司决定在年会之前公布调查结果，以安抚焦虑的投资者。

ex.en: Exercise prompts the body to release chemicals that improve mood and sharpen concentration.
ex.zh: 运动会促使身体释放能改善情绪、提高注意力的化学物质。

senses: n. 相关性；实用性；意义

ex.en: I don't see the relevance of your question.
ex.zh: 我不懂你这个问题有什么意义。

ex.en: The judge ruled that the evidence had no relevance to the case.
ex.zh: 法官裁定该证据与本案无关。

ex.en: Classical philosophy retains its relevance in the age of artificial intelligence.
ex.zh: 在人工智能时代，古典哲学仍然具有现实意义。

senses: a. 紧密相关的；切题的
adj. 有价值的；有意义的
relevant.usage: [族] relevance n. 相关性；[族] irrelevant adj. 无关的（反义）；relevant 指与可议论的话题或刚发生的事件有关，特别是逻辑关联；related 指有联系的、相关的；指人时着重亲戚关系；索引p415

ex.en: The incident is still under investigation by the relevant authorities.
ex.zh: 该事件仍在接受有关当局的调查。

ex.en: Applicants should highlight only the experience relevant to the position, rather than listing every job they have held.
ex.zh: 求职者应只突出与该职位相关的经历，而不是罗列自己做过的每一份工作。

ex.en: Some of the data collected a decade ago are no longer relevant to today's housing market.
ex.zh: 十年前收集的部分数据已不再适用于如今的房地产市场。

reliable.usage: [族] unreliable adj. 不可靠的（反义，链接P345）；[族] reliability n. 可靠性；adj.可靠的；真实可信的；性 能稳定的；索引p415

ex.en: Before citing a statistics website, researchers must confirm that it offers reliable data collected by recognised institutions.
ex.zh: 在引用某统计网站之前，研究人员必须确认其提供的是由权威机构收集的可靠数据。

ex.en: Public transport remains the most reliable way to reach the city centre during rush hours.
ex.zh: 在高峰时段，公共交通仍是前往市中心最可靠的出行方式。

ex.en: A reliable witness described the accident in detail, which helped the police reconstruct what had happened.
ex.zh: 一位可信的目击者详细描述了事故经过，帮助警方还原了事情原委。

phrases.p: young people's reliance on social media
phrases.m: 年轻人对社交媒体的依赖

ex.en: There may be costs associated with our increased reliance on the Internet.
ex.zh: 我们越来越依赖互联网可能会带来一些成本。

ex.en: The country aims to cut its reliance on imported oil.
ex.zh: 该国旨在减少对进口石油的依赖。

ex.en: Heavy reliance on a single customer makes the firm vulnerable.
ex.zh: 严重依赖单一客户使这家公司十分脆弱。

senses: n. 遗物;遗迹;遗风;遗俗;圣物;圣徒遗物

relief.usage: [族] relieve vt. 缓解；减轻；[族]relieve vt. 减轻；缓解；索引p415

ex.en: After the exam, I felt an incredible sense of relief.
ex.zh: 考试过后，我感到无比轻松。

ex.en: To the anxious travelers the sight of the American shore brought almost inexpressible relief.
ex.zh: 对那些焦急的旅客来说，看到美洲的海岸给人一种几乎难以用语言表达的宽慰。

ex.en: International agencies sent food and medical relief to the flooded region within forty-eight hours.
ex.zh: 国际机构在四十八小时之内向遭受洪灾的地区运送了食品和医疗救济物资。

relieve.usage: 同义release,ease,help,assist;反义intensify v.加强,加剧,使尖锐；v.减轻；缓和；v.缓解；减轻；发音类似“热离我”→发热远离我，就可以缓解我的症状→减轻，缓解。；词根:re(again重新)+lieve(light轻的)→使再次变轻→缓解；索引p415

ex.en: On July 29th they were relieved, at least temporarily.
ex.zh: 7月29日，他们松了一口气，至少是暂时的。

ex.en: Studies from the U.S. and Australia imply that taking a gap year helps relieve freshmen of pressures.
ex.zh: 美国和澳大利亚的研究表明，间隔年有助于缓解新生的压力。

ex.en: A short walk at lunchtime can relieve the stress that accumulates during a morning of intense work.
ex.zh: 午餐时散一小段步，可以缓解一上午紧张工作积累的压力。

religion.usage: [族] religious adj. 宗教的；虔诚的；索引p415

ex.en: This kind of thinking is why so many people try to avoid arguments, especially about politics and religion.
ex.zh: 这种想法就是为什么这么多人试图避免争论，特别是关于政治和宗教的争论。

ex.en: In that society, religion once shaped laws, education and almost every aspect of daily life.
ex.zh: 在那个社会，宗教曾塑造了法律、教育以及日常生活的几乎每一个方面。

ex.en: The constitution guarantees freedom of religion, allowing citizens to follow any faith or none at all.
ex.zh: 宪法保障宗教信仰自由，允许公民信奉任何宗教，也可以不信教。

senses: adj. 宗教的，信教的；虔诚的
religious.usage: adj.宗教的；虔诚的；真题词组亦见：religious drama 宗教戏剧；索引p415

ex.en: His wife is very religious.
ex.zh: 他的妻子非常虔诚。

ex.en: Many religious groups have joined campaigns against child poverty, providing shelters and free meals.
ex.zh: 许多宗教团体加入了消除儿童贫困的运动，提供收容所和免费餐食。

ex.en: Religious festivals still play a central role in the calendar of many rural communities.
ex.zh: 宗教节日在许多农村社区的历法中仍占据核心地位。

senses: vt. 享受，从……中获得乐趣
n. 食欲,胃口;意味,寓意
vt. 从某事物中获得乐趣;品味,享受

reluctant.usage: [族] reluctance n. 不情愿；勉强；派生reluctantly adv.勉强地；谐音法：发音类似“驴拉坦克”→驴怎么可能拉得动坦克呢？→勉强的。；发音类似“驴拉坦克”→驴怎么可能拉得动坦克呢？→勉强的。；索引p415

ex.en: So when one monkey was handed a grape in exchange for her token, the second was reluctant to hand hers over for a mere piece of cucumber.
ex.zh: 因此，当一只猴子用一个代币换到一颗葡萄时，第二只猴子就不愿意用代币仅仅换一片黄瓜了。

ex.en: Executives are often reluctant to admit mistakes in public, fearing that honesty will be read as weakness.
ex.zh: 高管们往往不愿公开承认错误，担心坦诚会被视为软弱。

ex.en: Farmers were reluctant at first to adopt the new method, but rising yields soon changed their minds.
ex.zh: 农民起初不愿采用新方法，但不断上升的产量很快使他们改变了想法。

phrases.p: rely on sb. to do sth.

rely.usage: [族] reliance n. 依赖；信任；[族] reliable adj. 可靠的（链接P217）；rely 指根据以往经验指望某人不会辜负希望或期待某事不落空；depend 指因自身能力不足而依赖别人给予帮助或支持；索引p415

ex.en: It is preferable for journalists to rely on their own notions of significance and make their own judgments.
ex.zh: 记者最好还是依靠自己对事件重要性的认识，作出自己的判断。

ex.en: Older residents in rural areas rely heavily on buses, so cutting these services would leave them isolated.
ex.zh: 农村的老年居民严重依赖公共汽车，因此削减这些服务会使他们陷入孤立。

ex.en: Modern scientists rely on peer review to filter out weak research before it reaches the public.
ex.zh: 现代科学家依靠同行评审，在薄弱的研究公之于众之前将其筛除。

senses: linking v. 仍然是；保持为

phrases.m: 情况仍未明,要看怎样发展

remain.usage: [近] stay vi. 保持；[族] remains n. 遗迹；遗体；2014年新题型例：locate buried remains 确定遗迹埋藏的位置；2021年新题型例：remain neutral 保持中立；索引p415

ex.en: There are many different types of automatic door, with each relying on specific signals to tell them when to open. Although these methods differ, the main principles remain the same.
ex.zh: 自动门有许多种,每一种都依赖于特定的信号来指示它们何时开启。虽然这些方法不同,主要原理依然相同。

ex.en: You might feel your heart racing or your face turning red, but do whatever you can to remain neutral in both your words and actions.
ex.zh: 你可能会感到心跳加速或脸红，但无论如何要在言行上保持中立。

ex.en: It remains to be seen how weather conditions affect the air flows that make formation flight more efficient.
ex.zh: 天气情况如何影响让编队飞行更高效的气流仍有待观察。

senses: n. 剩余物,剩余时间,残余部分;其他人员
n. 残余(物);遗迹,废墟;遗体
